transport_warning: This sharing site uses HTTP. The link and shared content travel without encryption. Someone observing the network may obtain both. HTTPS is recommended.
transport_ack: I understand the HTTP transport risk and want to create or update this link.
omission_help: Some content is omitted because its format or authorship can't be verified. Only verified messages can be selected.
title: Share conversation
intro: Anyone with the link can read the messages you choose. This doesn't give access to your account.
coverage: The source couldn't be covered completely. Refresh the catalog before sharing.
future_help: Only new completed messages after creation are included. Re-enabling skips the disabled interval.
tools_help: Include associated tool calls and intermediate work. Readers expand them manually.
cap: A link can last at most 30 days from its creation. Create a new link for a longer period.
warning: Redaction can miss sensitive facts. Review the entire preview before sharing. Images, attachments, active cards, thinking and identifying runtime details are omitted. Unproven automated or child messages are excluded.
ack: I've reviewed this preview and want to share this exact content and policy.
once: Copy this link now. It's shown only once and can't be recovered. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
copy_failed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy manually.
lost: The result may have been lost. Check existing links, revoke any uncertain link, then create a new one. Creation isn't retried automatically.
save_help: This changes what everyone with the link can read. Already downloaded content can't be recalled.
revoke_help: The link stops working. Already downloaded content can't be recalled. This can't be undone.
remove_help: Select shared messages to remove. Narrowing and revocation don't need the source computer online.
paused_help: The source changed or its limits were reached. Sealed history is kept; review a fresh preview to enable future sharing again.
scope_changed: The connection or assistant changed. Close this sheet and reopen it for the current conversation.
failure: Couldn't load or save sharing. Check the connection and retry.
conflict: Sharing changed elsewhere or the preview expired. Refresh and review a new preview before saving.
ownership_unbound: This conversation has no verified owner. A trusted administrator must explicitly attribute it before it can be shared.
owner_enrollment_required: This device isn't enrolled for sharing. Ask a trusted administrator to enroll its credential.
not_owner: Only the verified owner can share this conversation.
source_unsupported: This source doesn't support secure sharing yet.
source_incomplete: The complete source couldn't be verified. Nothing has been shared.
source_limit: This conversation exceeds secure sharing limits.
authority_unavailable: The authoritative assistant is unavailable. Existing links can still be narrowed or revoked when their original assistant is reachable.
manager_unsupported: This assistant doesn't support sharing yet.
public_origin_unavailable: An independent HTTP or HTTPS sharing site hasn't been configured. Ask a trusted administrator to configure it before creating links.
unavailable: Sharing isn't available for this conversation.
omission_unassociated_execution: Work not linked to a message
omission_component_incomplete: Part of the record was incomplete
omission_component_limit: Part of the record was too large
omission_other: Other content that can't be shared
